content.text: The data show the Core_mid zone (Zone_F3_Z01) temperature shifted upward after mid-2018 (monthly means 23→25°C) while other zones stayed flat. Crucially, the VAV_F3_Z01 damper setpoint doubled after July 2018 (mean 0.19→0.44, max 0.35→0.82), i.e. the controller is actively supplying substantially more cooling in response to perceived higher temperature/load. A passive sensor fault would not drive the damper to compensate. This is consistent with a real local load increase, not a faulty sensor.
